Going to have to leave my first bad review.

I only got a taste of this game, but I got all I wanted. The characters are lame as shit. Wouldn't normally bother me that much, but they're all so terribly borrowed. The sword guy looks like he's from Star Wars, we have a Master Chief like character, a Mushroom character, a Sniper who's voice just sounds too much like he's from Fallout.

The game-play realllly isn't my cup of tea. It somehow failed at trying to rip off what TF2 has going. You can't change class mid game. You basically cannot kill someone who does not want to be killed; with some characters. I mean you seriously have to shoot them for 30 seconds before getting close to a kill, and they can just bail at anytime to run back for health. Also, I have never been on so many one sided matches in a shooter before. Granted I didn't play for a huge sample size; I had matches where my team won 1000 to 50 (on command point game). The reverse happened as well, where we just got raped the entire match- not fun.

Three game types, two maps to each game type. The game is in that style where your character is fresh every match and you level up each match (you do unlock new level ups). Might as well name some good things. Over twenty characters to eventually unlock and play from. When the matches are really even (like 10% of matches?), and teams are working together; it can be pretty fun.

It was trying really hard to be a team oriented game, while it was obvious one or two players were carrying the team single highhandedly. Just get TF2, the free game with way more depth that this game failed to imitate (but with 'better' graphics).

Good review, Chiefpacman! You disliked the game but listed out exactly what elements you didn't enjoy and what it would take to improve them. I ended up enjoying Battleborn but I play it much more on the co-op story side than the multiplayer. I think there's a lot of potential here, but it sounds like Battleborn just didn't hit the mark for you. Are you interested in Overwatch's upcoming release?
